stem: Nora would like to close the first paragraph (sentences 1–5) with a sentence that tells what the story is about. Which of the following should Nora add after sentence 5?

options.label: A
options.text: For Jayden’s birthday they had wanted to do something special.

options.label: B
options.text: The balloons would fly effortlessly across the sky.

options.label: C
options.text: Today Jayden and his dad would be passengers on one of the balloons!

options.label: D
options.text: It was time for a birthday celebration!
